chapter: Bud Scott band instrumentation and repertoire
title: Banjo players, Percy and other local musicians
summary: Banjo players came later; he talks about Percy, now playing piano with Otis Smith in Ville Platte, and points the interviewers to Daley and the Horseshoe Circle.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Did they ever have any five string banjo players around here?
Well, hmm, sometime later they had quite a few. Then Percy came in, and I think that Percy came in, had, I think Percy was with Harry Walker.
And he, he went up to country, and I just, I have, he was with this boy out in New Orleans a while. Oh, just, I thought, hmm.
No, the other guy from New Orleans, you were talking about.

No, he had an orchestra in here then, there were two brothers, um, what was the boy's name? Heavy Dark Boys. Heavy Dark Boys? Yes, one, fli- What instrument? Flips. Uh, uh, uh, trump, uh, trumpet. I think the brother did. Yes, I know those fellas well, too, used to come in here quite a bit, go in here with him.
Well, we'll ask Percy about it when we go in.
Percy, where you find Percy? Percy can tell you how great he is. You say Percy's in Villeplatt now. He's in Villeplatt with, with Otis. Otis Smith.

And, uh, I think Percy's, he's playing, uh, he's playing piano now. But he was, well, he was stringing instrument all the way around because he, from guitar to banjo, and, uh, he tried to play bass a little, but now he's strictly, he's, he's playing piano. Playing piano now together. I thought that, uh, I was thinking that they'd be up here, I think one, one night next week, if I'm not mistaken. But, uh, you could, uh, go up on Franklin Street, uh, a boy works in the Savoy Grill by the name of, uh, Daley. And Daley could tell you when, that he would be in there. I think that he's, uh, sponsoring a dance out at the Horseshoe Circle. Or you could call anyone that's connected out there in the Horseshoe Circle. And I think they, they gave him, because they came here and told me, he says, uh, uh, one of the boys was in here, his father passed last week. And he told me, he says, uh, Mitchell said, we want you when we come out to see how David Hawkins has changed from, uh, he and I was, used to play guitar together and banjo. And, uh, he, uh, he's changed now. He said, he's just one of those. And he told me, I said, I want you to come out to see. But after my people got sick, I just didn't have any help, so I had to stop to help those. And, uh, that fire just, just taking all the run out of me, I just, just forgotten it. And, uh, maybe if I hadn't got a pretty good job, I'd have maybe been trying to baffle around, trying to play the music until, yeah.
